title: StormReady
text:
| NWS StormReady® ProgramWorking Toward a Weather-Ready Nation | 
 
 | ||
| 
 StormReady communities, counties, Indian nations, universities and colleges, military bases, government sites, commercial enterprises and other groups are better prepared to save lives from the onslaught of severe weather through advanced planning, education and awareness. No community is storm proof, but StormReady can help communities save lives. StormReady uses a grassroots approach to help communities develop plans to handle all types of extreme weather—from tornadoes to winter storms. The program encourages communities to take a new, proactive approach to improving local hazardous weather operations by providing emergency managers with clear-cut guidelines on how to improve their hazardous weather operations.  To apply, see the How to Become StormReady page. Your local NWS office Warning Coordination Meteorologist will walk you through the easy application process. Sites that can't meet the StormReady criteria can show their support for weather safety by becoming a Weather-Ready Nation (WRN) Ambassador. |
